historical_record.description: The Sutro Grammar School, an 18-classroom school, wood-framed above a reinforced-concrete basement, with metal-lath plaster walls and a tile roof, was taken over by the Board of Education; designed in the city's Bureau of Architecture, it was built by the Finlayson-Stettin Co. on a $60,000 general contract.
